notes: A RULING RELABEL. Brandon 2026-10-02 PRE31-C ruling (A): a macro that, in any build configuration or on any runtime path, does not evaluate an argument is unsafe under PRE31-C as written (ADR-0001), including one that evaluates it once or not at all. Each row was re-derived at the pinned commit from the macro's definitions and the argument's callees, judged strict (ADR-0015 D5) under the owned-storage ruling. Tag counts: {'call-side-effect-unproven': 9, 'library-contract trust: contract:stdlib_call_effects': 18}. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here. Added after review: the census gap, rows whose recorded reason rests on the overturned premise in a template the first census missed (curl DEBUGASSERT 'referenced at most once in every branch'), plus sel4 fastpath.c:669, riscv boot.c:437 (arm boot.c:148, listed by the reviewer, re-derived FP: the argument-dropping arm never compiles with that line), sqlite btree.c:11453, os_win.c:3544, printf.c:929 and pureftpd log_mysql.c:360.
